content: The tree effigy locations in Grand Theft Auto 6 are key to finding Mr. Mangrove, the mythical Skunk Ape in Pelican Valley. An odd fellow named Kirk is hunting the Skunk Ape, and since Jason and Lucia have been marked by Skunk Ape spores, Kirk has decided that they're the ideal companions to join the hunt and find Mr. Mangrove's tree effigies.
